source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag ACU Top-Load Dryer Technical Manual (WED5100/WGD5100)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Mode entered. Use Service Diagnostics (HMI Test, Sensor Feedback, Diagnostic Cycle) as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Door status in service mode
steps.body: Service Diagnostics → Sensor Feedback → Door Switch — open/close changes display (0=open, 1=closed).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostics → Sensor Feedback → Door Switch — open/close changes display (0=open, 1=closed).

steps.title: J8-3 to J8-4 bench check
steps.body: Power off. Door closed: 0–2 Ω across J8-3 and J8-4.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Door closed: 0–2 Ω across J8-3 and J8-4.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door switch; retest Quick Diagnostic.

steps.title: Door switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: Door switch diagnostic and bench checks pass.
